The published developer and provider of the **Prompt Sloth Write Better AI Prompts** Chrome extension and service at **promptsloth.com** is **Eric Strohmaier** (operating under the brand **Prompt Sloth**).

* **Evidence & Provider Statement:** 
  * The official site's founder page states: *"Prompt Sloth is built by Eric Strohmaier, a solo founder. 10000+ people use the extension to write better AI prompts in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and more."*
  * The Privacy Policy on `promptsloth.com` establishes the provider entity: *"This Privacy Policy explains how Prompt Sloth ('we,' 'our,' or 'us') handles your data when you use our browser extension, desktop app and website."*
